name: git-autosync
description: Puts a project into a known-good git state before the first prompt of every session: fast-forwards the default branch (main, falling back to master) from the first remote, creates Claude Code worktrees off the freshly synced branch, initializes submodules recursively, and attaches each top-level submodule to the superproject's branch instead of a detached HEAD. Does nothing outside a git repo or in a repo with no remote, and never fails a session.
